'''Stealth suits''' were a type of clothing produced by many companies across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Made from a variety of different materials and technologies dependent on manufacturer, the main function of all stealth suits was to conceal the wearer and make it difficult to detect visually or through the use of technology. Some devices focused on optical camouflage, silhouette breakers, thermal sinks, and sound deadeners.<ref name="EV" />
